title: Add a valid task comment
preconditions: Logged in as a staff user who belongs to the task list's group; at least one task exists in that list
steps: 1. Open the task list and click the task title. 2. Scroll to 'Add comment'. 3. Type 'M3-01 valid comment'. 4. Click 'Add Comment'. 5. Refresh the page.
expected_result: Green 'Comment posted' message; comment shows under 'Comments on this task' with your username and date; still shown after refresh

title: Submit an empty comment and check validation
steps: 1. Open the same task. 2. Leave the comment box empty. 3. Click 'Add Comment'. 4. Check the comments list. (Optional: type only spaces and submit.)
expected_result: Manual: browser blocks submission with 'Please fill out this field' and no comment is added. Automated (direct POST bypassing the browser): server should reject blank comment - fails on 2.7.0

title: Search for a known task keyword
preconditions: Logged in as staff user in the group; a task exists whose title contains a known word (e.g. 'invoice')
steps: 1. Use the search box (or open /todo/search/?q=invoice - adjust the prefix to your GTD URL). 2. Submit. 3. Repeat with the keyword in CAPITALS.
expected_result: Results page lists the matching task with its list name; count shows '1 search results'; tasks from groups you are not in are not listed

title: Search for a keyword with no matching tasks
expected_result: Page loads normally and shows 'No results to show, sorry.'; no task titles listed; no error page
